findings.fix: Encode 7 words; independently walk lowering lengths and validate final emitted instruction stream before rebuilding DXBC.

findings.issue: Each fresh fixed source snapshot realized a new immutable GPU buffer and SRV.
findings.fix: Reuse a dynamic WRITE_DISCARD carrier per D3D recording context; device teardown releases caches.
